Need a place for toilet paper but don’t have wall space? This vanity top toilet tissue holder is a countertop toilet paper holder (also called a toilet tissue holder or toilet roll holder) designed to sit on the vanity top so a roll stays close at hand in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

Highlights
- Conserve wall space in a small bathroom or powder room with a vanity-top, counter-set design
- Keep toilet tissue accessible next to the sink for guests and daily routines

- Offered in multiple designer finish options to match versatile bath accessories across the room

- Assembled in the USA
